question: what drug or combination of drugs is most popular for treating stage 4 copd?

question: what is a t wave abnormality?
gt_answer: T wave abnormalities are commonly seen on the electrocardiogram (EKG: tests that record heartbeat) [11728347]. They may be harmless [11728347, 32259342] or they may predict life-threatening conditions [15842426, 32975832]. Tall or prominent T-waves may be a sign of heart attack [11992348, 2301787]. Inverted T-wave (a deep in the recorded line) is linked to coronary heart disease [32975832]. Deep inverted symmetric T-waves called "cerebral T-waves" are seen in stroke patients[34239799]. Peaked T waves are the most frequent change in patients with kidney problems [31686358].

T-wave inversion is frequently seen in myocardial infarction and may indicate silent myocardial ischemia [22179535, 18606329, 25970951]. These findings are common in non–ST-segment elevation acute coronary syndromes and are associated with risk of sudden cardiac death [29432131, 15618066, 17897130]. Markedly/deeply inverted T-waves in Wellens’ syndrome suggest critical LAD stenosis, whereas T-wave alternans predicts potentially fatal arrhythmias [21140289, 26603327, 23870659]. T-wave abnormalities may also arise from noncardiac pathophysiology and are associated with subclinical atherosclerosis [33420509, 18606329, 16308114]. T-wave oversensing may lead to inappropriate ICD shocks, and T-wave changes may be observed following accessory pathway ablation [18616439, 18709008, 28353570]. Nondisjunction can be caused by the genes and environment [7789361]. During meiosis, both women's eggs and male sperm may have faulty chromosomes. When removing the cyst, the surgeon will try to do it through a small cut (laparoscopy) or fall back to opening the abdomen (laparotomy) [11044507]. After laparoscopy, in a small number of patients, the cysts may form again [17022919], particularly if the contents of the cyst spills into abdomen [33279627]. Spillage of the cyst content into abdomen, which is rare, may cause inflammation in the abdomen (peritonitis) [10527327, 33279627].  Major surgery effects include accidental cuts to bowels and ureter (the tube that carries urine from the kidney to the bladder)[11044507]. During surgery, small blood vessels may be nicked [11044507] and there may be some blood loss [17022919].  After surgery, inflammation may develop around the cut [10527327] or a part of the organ may come through the cut (incisional hernia) [11044507]. A major long-term risk of the surgery is infertility [28089684, 36971598, 36120464]. Infertility is more common among women who had cyst surgery, all other causes of infertility being equal to women without surgery [36971598]. question: what are the symptoms and treatments for ibs?
gt_answer: Symptoms of irritable bowel syndrome (IBS) are long-standing abdominal pain and changes in bowel habits that have no clear causes [30466670, 38078610]. Changes in bowel habits include diarrhea (IBS-D), constipation (IBS-D)[34463082], mixed stool pattern (IBS-M, which includes constipation and diarrhea)[34927757], and unclassified IBS [34463082]. Depending on the type of IBS, symptoms are managed by different drugs and other methods, such as brain-gut behavioral therapies (BGBTs) [38078610].  Lifestyle and dietary changes, such as probiotics, a low fermentable oligosaccharides, disacchardies, monosaccharides, polyols (FODMAP) diet, or gluten-free diet, are the first treatment for all patients [31820883, 34249316]. Laxatives are used to treat IBS-C [33315591], e.g., linaclotide, lubiprostone, plecanatide [30466670], although lubiprostone and linaclotide may be recommended when other laxatives do not work [34463082]. For IBS-D, rifaximin [33315591, 35738725] eluxadoline [30466670, 35738725], alosetron, loperamide [35738725], alosetron and ramosetron [34249316] may be recommended. For IBS-D and IBS-M additional treatments may include faecal microbial transplant [34927757] or alternative treatments, including psychotherapy, hypnotherapy, acupuncture or herbs [31820883]. The effectiveness  of these ternative treatments is not clear [36507830].
